title: Music (music/*.json)
description: One music spec per JSON file under music/. The file stem is the spec id. Specified-prompt music generation; unused optional keys are omitted.

prompt.description: Music description sent to ACE-Step as prompt. Prose, not tag arrays.

lyrics.description: Lyrics as a single string. Omit when unused.

vocal_language.description: Vocal language code (e.g. ja, en). Omit when unused.

duration.description: Audio duration in seconds. Mapped to ACE-Step audio_duration. Omit when unused.

bpm.description: Beats per minute. Omit when unused.
